//: Windows Terminal fragment merged into settings.json by install.ps1.
//keys: install.ps1 merges 'schemes' by name, 'profiles.defaults' key-by-key, and 'actions' by keys chord. Everything else in your settings.json is left untouched. Your original is backed up first.
//nobind: Deliberately NOT bound here: ctrl+a and ctrl+h/j/k/l. You run WSL inside this terminal, and Windows Terminal consumes a chord before the shell ever sees it. Binding either would mean herdr/tmux never receive its prefix or its pane-focus keys. WT's own pane keys therefore live on alt+arrows instead.

schemes.//: Same palette as ghostty/config.shared: #0a0a0a ground, #22d3ee cyan accent, #163b44 selection.
schemes.name: Terminal Setup Dark

actions.//: Splits mirror herdr/tmux intent (| side-by-side, - stacked) but on alt+shift, since ctrl+a is reserved for the WSL multiplexer prefix.
Pane focus on alt+arrows, NOT ctrl+h/j/k/l — see //nobind above.
Same chord as ghostty's ctrl+shift+m=toggle_maximize. Safe inside WSL too: herdr's zoom is prefix+m (ctrl+a m), so the two never collide.
Resize on alt+shift+arrows, the analogue of herdr/tmux prefix+h/j/k/l.
